title: add-phasewise-token-latency-matrix-and-cost-cascade-playback
author: Maeve Chen
description: Motivation: We've been seeing unexplained long-tail token latency spikes across multi-stage model pipelines. Existing dashboards show aggregate p95/p99 but lack phase-separation (tokenization, encoder, kv-lookup, attention, decode) and a way to replay cost impact over time. This PR introduces a phasewise token latency matrix collector, a compact cost-cascade visualizer for the Console, and lightweight trace enrichment so sampled spans include token-phase breakpoints. Changes include: new prometheus/OTel metrics (phase_duration_ms{phase,model,variant,route}), an internal compact histogram rollup for UI tiling, a dashboard JSON with interactive playback slider, and an alert tuning guide to reduce noisy p99 alerts by gating on phase-contributed proportion. Implementation notes: collector implemented as a thin runtime hook (serving/runtime/phase_collector.cc) with guarded sampling to avoid alloc overhead in hot paths; trace decorator adds a small token-phase array to span tags when trace sampling is active. UI: Console dashboard panels added under Observability -> Token Cost & Latency -> Phase Matrix. Rollout plan: staged flag (observability.phase_matrix.enabled) default off; enable first for staging customers, opt-in for high-volume tenants. Linear references: ENG-3489 (collector), ENG-3514 (dashboard + alerting). Testing: unit tests for histogram rollup, e2e replaybench run against synthetic workload. Backwards-compatibility: all metrics are additive; no breaking rename. Checklist: [x] collector impl + tests, [x] dashboard JSON, [x] trace enrichment, [x] alert tuning doc, [x] staging flag & feature gate remove plan. Related: touches parts of runtime, telemetry ingestion, and Console.

review_comments: Jordan Lee: Nice separation between phases. Please add a short module-level comment explaining why we use a compact rollup vs full histogram to avoid confusion when ingesting metrics.
Maeve Chen (author): Added comment and extended unit test to cover edge cases for single-token spans.
Priya Singh: How do we avoid increasing cardinality with model+variant+phase tags? Can we collapse rare variants?
Maeve Chen (author): We cap cardinality in registry.yaml and fallback to variant='other' when seen tags exceed threshold; noted in rollout doc.
Luca Romano: Alert tuning doc shows reduction in noise but we should bias p99 gating to token-phase > 40% contribution. Add a flag for teams to choose threshold.
Maeve Chen (author): Exposed observability.alert.phase_contrib_threshold in flags and updated docs.
release_notes: Adds a phase-separated token latency matrix and a cost-cascade playback dashboard to help diagnose long-tail latency. Shipped behind a feature flag; includes alert tuning guidance to reduce noisy p99 alerts.
